header.sector: Optical interconnects, transceivers and datacenter networking
header.title: AI datacenter shift to VCSEL NPO optical interconnects lifts named VCSEL suppliers

s01_bottom_line.text: TrendForce projects VCSEL sales to reach 650 million units by 2031 at a 38% CAGR from 2025, driven by AI datacenter demand for short-reach optical interconnects, with six named suppliers investing in VCSEL NPO. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
If the projected VCSEL volume growth materializes, named suppliers developing VCSEL NPO could see rising demand, though the article does not quantify revenue or earnings effects for any company.

items.text: VCSEL sales are projected to grow at a 38% CAGR from 2025 to 2031. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
Copper signal attenuation is expected to accelerate the transition to optical interconnect technologies including VCSEL NPO and Micro LED CPO.
Several VCSEL NPO solutions are expected to launch between 2027 and 2028.
Six major suppliers are investing heavily in VCSEL NPO R&D.
Coherent, Broadcom, ams OSRAM and HiSilicon use mature 850nm VCSELs with photodiodes to achieve aggregate bandwidth up to 3.2 Tbps.
Lumentum and Furukawa Electric adopted higher-cost 1,060nm VCSEL solutions; Coherent plans to adopt this approach.
